## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace --all-features` pass
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests (mock tests; live tests only if necessary)
- [ ] Public API changes are documented, and any new dependency is justified
- [ ] I agree my contribution is licensed under `MIT OR Apache-2.0`
